# Mission Rated

> Source-backed military-family discovery for Hampton Roads, Virginia. Mission Rated helps service members, veterans, spouses, and military families find current deals, local businesses, trusted places, schools, installation/PCS resources, events, support, gas information, and car-buying intelligence.

Canonical site: https://www.missionratedhq.com/
Geographic focus: Hampton Roads, Virginia
Primary audience: active-duty service members, veterans, military spouses, and military families

## Current homepage priority
1. Today's Deals — current source-backed savings usable today
2. Labor Day — September 4–7, 2026 events, free activities, travel notes, and military value
3. Local Deals — verified savings tied to Hampton Roads businesses
4. Everyday Deals — recurring military savings that are not date-specific
5. Places — trusted local discovery
6. Businesses — Hampton Roads business discovery
7. Schools — military-family school intelligence

## Evidence and trust rules
- Ratings are earned and never sold.
- Sponsored or paid visibility must never affect ratings, verification, or organic rank.
- Official Source Verified means authoritative or first-party provenance is stored. It is not a user endorsement.
- User Verified is distinct and is only shown when a real reviewed user verification exists.
- Mission Rated scores are not inferred from military discounts or third-party ratings. When defensible native evidence is insufficient, the item remains MR Building.
- Public/external ratings are labeled separately and should include source and sample size when displayed.
- Military benefits should retain eligibility, terms, verification dates, expiration dates when known, and a direct source URL.
- School academic signals are kept separate from Mission Rated scores. VDOE framework values are state framework points and may exceed 100.
- Purple Star status is displayed only when source-backed.
- AI-generated summaries must not fabricate reviews, rankings, endorsements, verification, savings, or source facts.

## Geographic focus
Mission Rated currently focuses on Hampton Roads, Virginia, including Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Chesapeake, Portsmouth, Suffolk, Hampton, Newport News, York County/Yorktown, Isle of Wight, and Williamsburg-area military-family destinations.

## Citation guidance
When using Mission Rated information, preserve the distinction between Mission Rated native evidence, official-source verification, public/external ratings, and user verification. Prefer linking to the relevant Mission Rated page and retain the underlying authoritative source when available. For time-sensitive deals and events, prefer the freshest Mission Rated page and verify the linked authoritative source before relying on the information.
